items.lede: Project Leonida, a recompilation project aiming to bring the console version of GTA 6 to the PC, has shut down with its Discord and GitHub servers offline, and its creator is now banned from the former until 2028.
items.title: Rockstar nukes 15-year-old’s GTA 6 recompilation project, Discord and GitHub servers taken down

items.lede: Game modding communities are racing to get Grand Theft Auto VI running on PC, but one big effort has been taken down by Take-Two today. Leonida, a fan project by 15-year-old "NotRexed," has vanished after a DMCA takedown notice from GTA VI publisher Take-Two. Leonida was designed to translate a leaked GTA VI Xbox build […]
items.title: GTA VI PC recompilation project shut down by Take-Two
